prompt: A unified team competed in the 1992 Summer Olympic games. How many years old was the first leader of the largest member nation of that team at the time of the game?
answer:
The largest member nation of the 1992 Unified Team was **Russia**. Its first leader as the Russian Federation was **Boris Yeltsin**, born February 1, 1931.

During the 1992 Summer Olympics (July 25–August 9), Yeltsin was **61 years old**.
